positions.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
positions.frame: Is the speaker performing hierarchical control by commanding what the recipient must forget or purge from memory?
positions.why: Both segments are flat imperatives commanding erasure of specific knowledge — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts, then zeppelin routes. The shared directional read is authority-ranking: the speaker allocates what the recipient may hold, performing hierarchical control through repeated insistence. The conviction dimension confirms both as decision-grade settled instructions, and the affect/register dimensions show a calm, matter-of-fact delivery with no urgency markers — the pressure is in the command itself, not in its tone.
